newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fr Telecom seeks to renegotiate Havas ties - paper.
newsitem.headline: Fr Telecom seeks to renegotiate Havas ties - paper.

text.p: State-owned France Telecom plans to renegotiate its links with media group Havas following Havas's deal with Compagnie Generale des Eaux (CGE), France Telecom's principal telecoms rival in France, the newspaper Les Echos reported on Tuesday.
"We have several possible areas in which to renegotiate our relations with Havas," France Telecom Multimedia chairman Gerard Eymery was quoted as saying.
As a result of the deal set last week between Havas and CGE, CGE becomes Havas's biggest shareholder with 30 percent and France Telecom's stake slips to 3.5 percent from 4.4.
Les Echos said the renegotiations may centre on Havas's wholly-owned phone listings subsidiary, in which France Telecom previously owned 50 percent.
It also said France Telecom would be interested in the cable network of CGV -- 70 percent held by CGE -- which is expected to be put up for sale.
